steps.en: Company details are filled in automatically from MyInfo Business
steps.id: Detail company terisi otomatis dari MyInfo Business
steps.why_en: Only the company name is filled in; phone and email must be typed.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama company yang terisi; telepon dan email harus diketik sendiri.

steps.en: Company name is locked; only allowed fields can be edited
steps.id: Nama company terkunci; hanya field yang diizinkan bisa diubah
steps.why_en: The Clear button unlocks the company name, and nothing checks it later.
steps.why_id: Tombol Clear membuka kunci nama company, dan tidak ada pengecekan setelahnya.

steps.en: The company contact number can be changed
The company email address can be changed
The amended values go into the submission
steps.id: Nilai yang diubah masuk ke submission
